change_summary: Close governing-owner corrections across the old Project neighborhood, preserve repeated CLI receipts, and normalize bounded operation waits without moving semantic planning into Runtime.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill and API require an enduring-owner correction to carry the old Project and reconcile its remaining branches instead of accepting a named-child-only move.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-16.7 aligns Reply, direct organization and RunOps on governing-owner neighborhood closure; transport also expands repeated same-command CLI receipts and caps positive operation waits at the advertised maximum.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.56; compatibility family, minimum revision, write consent and installation scope remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.34 and remain compatible with contract 2026-09-16.7; the changed receipt collector is test-Harness code, not a published CLI command.

help_center.note: Public MCP guidance now explains that an enduring-owner correction includes the old Project neighborhood and is not complete after only the named child moves.

package_setup.note: README and SessionStart expose release 1.7.56 and the compact old-Project handoff boundary without asking the Host to design Corvio topology.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline records immutable multi-receipt evaluation, typed wait normalization and the semantic completion boundary for corrected Project ownership while preserving Runtime as a protocol executor.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party 1.7.56 publication, hashes, fresh released-host loading and deployed OAuth/MCP behavior remain release receipts; external directory acceptance remains outside the repository boundary.

release_evidence.note: Focused guards cover package freshness, old-root handoff and planning semantics; fresh released-host trigger, transfer and countercase effects plus authoritative Tree readback remain the live gate.
